methodology: Measures ONLY evidence/adapters.py transformation latency (pure Python, no network/LLM calls) - excludes retrieval latency, external API latency, and Cerebras/LLM latency entirely, per directive Step 19. Population: all 58 development+validation real records from artifacts/v2/phase5_benchmark_manifest.json (phase5_heldout excluded, kept spent), each adapter call repeated 20x to stabilize the distribution (pure-function repeatability, not a re-scoring of held-out data).

coverage.duplicates_removed: N/A - this benchmark does not dedupe across cases (dedup is a downstream/consumer concern per the frozen contract, not an adapter responsibility)

explicit_non_claims: Phase 5 does not improve network/API latency.
Phase 5 does not improve LLM/Cerebras latency.
This benchmark measures Python-side transformation cost only.
